lead_raw_text:
The structure of Gd2Ti6Cu2Se12 (reduced formula GdTi3CuSe6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 22 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Gd each adopt octahedral coordination by six Se atoms, while Ti centers have six Se neighbors, and Se centers have four geometric neighbors (one Cu, one Gd, two Ti). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Cu and Ti, Gd and Ti, and edge-sharing between Cu and Gd octahedra.
